name: CodeForces
intro: Codeforces 是公开竞赛编程平台与题源，不是具有固定题数、划分和评分协议的单一 benchmark。模型报告必须自行声明比赛时间窗、题目子集、提示、尝试预算、在线或离线判题路径及聚合方式；只有协议一致的结果才可直接比较。
build_method: 报告自行选择Codeforces比赛与题目, 固定提示和尝试预算, 声明在线或离线评测器
metric: 报告相关：Accuracy, Pass@k, Rank, Rating
eval_feature: 官方题面与元数据, 可选官方提交判题, 协议披露边界
scale: 无固定规模；由各模型报告定义
build_method_en: Report-defined Codeforces contest and problem selection, frozen prompt and attempt budget, declared online or offline judge
eval_feature_en: Official statements and metadata, optional official-platform judging, explicit protocol boundary
intro_en: Codeforces is a public competitive-programming platform and problem source, not one benchmark with a fixed item count, split, or scoring protocol. Model reports must define their contest window, problem subset, prompt, attempt budget, online or offline judging route, and aggregation; only runs with the same protocol are directly comparable.
scale_en: No fixed scale; defined by each model report
drawio_review_note: Evidence-bounded to the official Codeforces API documentation and official Codeforces rating-system documentation. Codeforces is a continuously operated competitive-programming platform, not a standalone benchmark paper or one fixed evaluation set. Its public objects expose contests, problems, difficulty ratings, tags, standings, submissions, test sets, resource consumption, points, penalties, and verdicts. A model report must therefore define its own contest window, problem subset, contamination policy, prompt, programming language, attempt budget, tools, and online or offline judge. When solutions are submitted online, Codeforces supplies the platform verdicts; an offline harness is a separate report-specific choice and must be fully specified. Accuracy/Pass@k and contest rank/rating are alternative aggregations, not universal interchangeable Codeforces metrics, so the diagram does not invent a canonical item count, split, prompt, sampling budget, or score.
